    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs
FROM Deliveries d

  AND pm.team_name = 'India'

  AND d.noballs = 0
GROUP BY p.player_id
ORDER BY total_runs DESC
LIMIT 5;

JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL
  AND m.result_type IN ('runs', 'wickets')
  AND d.inning = 1
  AND d.batting_team = m.match_winner
GROUP BY m.match_id
HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) < 100;

SELECT venue, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_runs
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.season = 'Test'  -- Assuming Test matches are identified by season
GROUP BY venue
HAVING MAX(runs_scored) < 100  -- No century scored at this venue
ORDER BY total_runs DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.player_name, 
       COUNT(*) AS not_out_innings
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
WHERE m.start_date >= '2016-01-01'
  AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
GROUP BY p.player_id
ORDER BY not_out_innings DESC
LIMIT 10;
